attempts.text: {"claims":[{"claim_text":"The Republican party has long advocated for the independence of Lithuania, Latvia, and Estonia, even when others despaired of their emergence from foreign rule.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Republican party strongly supports the Ukrainian and Armenian people, who have endured persecution and tyranny to reassert their nationhood.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States should promote reconciliation and friendship between the United States and Russia, and between Russia and its neighbors.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The current administration has damaged the NATO alliance with years of insensitivity and episodic attention.", "claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"In the Yugoslav war, the current administration bungled the diplomacy, misjudged the adversary, and ignored the advice of military commanders.", "claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Even after NATO's operations in Bosnia and Kosovo revealed Europe's lagging military capabilities, the current administration failed to persuade allies to enhance those capabilities.", "claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The next Republican administration will work to repair damage to the NATO alliance.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
